name: Kempinski Hotel Ishtar Dead Sea
positioning: Kempinski Hotel Ishtar Dead Sea, a resort on the shores of the Dead Sea in Jordan, with swimming pools overlooking the Dead Sea and a kids club
best_for: Travelers who want a Dead Sea shoreline base in Jordan
Families who want a kids club on site

facts.text: The hotel is located by the shores of the Dead Sea.
The hotel's address is Swaimeh, Amman, Jordan.
The hotel's celestial swimming pools have views of the Dead Sea.
The Infinity pool is reserved for guests aged 18 and above.
The pools include a heated kids pool.
The Titan Tikes Kids Club is open to children aged between 2 and 12.
The room rate includes buffet breakfast, a complimentary minibar replenished once per day, and complimentary Wi-Fi.
The fitness centre has personal trainers available on request.

highlights.text: Each guest is welcomed by the hotel's Lady in Red, a host with knowledge of the hotel and the local area.
The Titan Tikes Kids Club is located on the ground floor of the Ishtar building behind the Akkad restaurant.
The concierge team can advise on and arrange trips to Petra and Wadi Rum.
The hotel offers chauffeur-driven airport transfers to and from Queen Alia International Airport, booked through the concierge.

considerations.text: The hotel has a no visitor policy to enhance privacy for guests.
Food and alcoholic beverages may not be brought into the hotel, and alcohol brought in is removed from luggage and stored until departure.
The primary guest must be at least 18 years old to check in.
